text:
maria: Pushing private/VPC airgap bundle v1.5.0-rc1 now. Need quick check on cosign blobs, checksums, and the delivery manifest before we open the change window at 23:00 UTC.

ajay: Thanks — I can verify cosign sigs and sha256s. Which registry snapshot and installer tar name?

maria: Registry snapshot: reg.redwood-inference.local:5000/redwood/private:v1.5.0-rc1
Installer: redwood-onprem-installer-1.5.0-rc1.tgz
Manifest: s3://redwood-artifacts/private/v1.5.0-rc1/manifest.json

ajay: Running cosign verify: `cosign verify -key kms://projects/redwood/keys/release ./bundle.sig`
Got one failure on node-selinux image signature, investigating.

packaging-bot: [deploy-bot] uploaded bundle to s3://redwood-artifacts/private/v1.5.0-rc1 (size: 1.8GB)

devin: I can start a small canary in the Dublin VPC for the Dedicated customer VM set. Suggest 10% of hosts, 30m soak. If canary is green we promote. Window OK for 23:00–02:00 UTC?

lina: Heads up — KMS key rotation scheduled yesterday. Ajay, are you pulling cosign public key from the new key URI or the old one? We had a key alias change; that may explain the sig miss.

ajay: Ah yeah, using `kms://projects/redwood/keys/releases-v1` should be the new alias. Re-running verify now.

release-bot: [release-bot] cosign verify reports: all signatures valid (after key alias switch). Checksums: `sha256: a3f5...c9b1` for installer tgz.

maria: Great. Ops — can you prepare presigned download and the courier manifest for the partner airgap delivery? We need checksum, cosign sig, and package size in the courier email.

ops: Preparing. Will upload presigned artefacts to partner SFTP and send courier manifest by 21:30 UTC. SFTP details will be sent in-thread. Also scheduling a secondary delivery window on 02:30 UTC in case of rollback.

ajay: Also added a quick smoke test script in the bundle: `tests/quick_start_smoke.sh` — please run on canary nodes. Exit 0 expected.

devin: Canary started @ 23:05 UTC. Running smoke — first run failed due to configmap mount path mismatch. Deploy team fixing an env var (REDWOOD_DATA_DIR). Patch pushed and re-deployed, smoke now passing.

maria: Thanks — note for release notes: "Private installer v1.5.0-rc1: KMS-signed artifacts, smaller registry snapshot, improved KV cache config defaults." I'll draft release notes after final promotion.

lina: Security reviewed the cosign provenance and the manifest. No unexpected layers. Approve for private delivery.

ops: Partner SFTP upload complete. Manifest and checksums included. Courier notified.

release-bot: [release-bot] Promotion to 'private-stable' tag scheduled at 00:45 UTC. Auto-rollback on healthcheck fail within 15m.

devin: Canary metrics look stable (p50 latency -2ms vs baseline, error rate 0.1%). Proceeding with staggered promotion.

ajay: Post-promotion verification: cosign sig matches, sha256 OK.

maria: Promoted at 00:47 UTC. Closing change window early; will monitor for 2h. If anything pops up, we'll trigger rollback plan ROLLBACK-2026-05-17-A.

ops: Noted. Courier confirmed delivery to partner registry; vendor confirmed successful import.

maria: Final: release notes drafted and pushed to docs site. Big thanks all — kudos :tada:

packaging-bot: [packaging-bot] release notes link: https://docs.redwood.ai/private/releases/1.5.0-rc1

maria: Thread resolved.
